Charholi Pune Location – A Smart Choice for Homebuyers

One of the key highlights of Prism City Green is its prime location in Charholi. This area has seen massive infrastructure growth and is quickly becoming a preferred residential destination.

Top Location Benefits:

  • Excellent Road Connectivity: With direct access to the Pune-Nashik Highway and Alandi Road, commuting becomes easier.

  • Close to Pune International Airport: Residents enjoy the convenience of quick travel, especially for frequent flyers.

  • IT Parks Nearby: The project offers easy access to EON IT Park, Magarpatta City, and other business hubs.

  • Educational Institutions: DY Patil Knowledge City and Symbiosis are just a short drive away.

  • Healthcare Access: Columbia Asia and Sahyadri Hospitals ensure medical care is always within reach.

  • Leisure & Shopping: Malls like Phoenix Marketcity and Seasons Mall provide ample options for entertainment and retail therapy.

In short, living in Charholi Pune location means enjoying the perks of city life while staying connected to nature and peace.

4 BHK Units
